lines.text: A quarter circle fills pi over four of this square. So four times the share inside lands near pi.
lines.caption: A quarter circle fills π/4 of this square. So 4 × the share inside lands near π.

lines.text: One hundred darts. A rough guess.
lines.caption: 100 darts. A rough guess.

lines.text: A hundred thousand darts, and we get three point one four.
lines.caption: 100,000 darts, and we get 3.14.

lines.text: But it is slow. Every extra correct digit needs about a hundred times more darts.
lines.caption: But it's slow. Every extra correct digit needs about 100× more darts.

lines.text: How many darts would you need for three point one four one five nine?
lines.caption: How many darts would you need for 3.14159?

post.title: Random darts find π
post.description: Random darts in a square: the share that lands inside the quarter circle, times 4, creeps towards π. 100,000 darts give 3.14, but every extra digit needs about 100× more. Narrated with an AI voice. Animation made with code.
post.pinned_comment: Guess: how many darts for 3.14159? And what else should we throw at π?
